compute_relative_pose: compute the relative SE3 pose transform between two camera poses using get_rel_pose
predict_log_depth_kriging: predict log depth at test locations from training depths using Gaussian process kriging via predict_log_depth
project_3d_points: project 3D points to 2D image coordinates with camera intrinsics using projection and get the Jacobian
transform_3d_points: transform 3D points between coordinate frames using transformPoints and get derivatives w.r.t. pose and points
backproject_2d_to_3d: backproject 2D image coordinates with depth values to 3D points using backprojection with camera intrinsics
